messages:
Lina: Quick morning scrub — currently 82 open tickets, 11 high-priority, 3 active P1s from last night. If you're on triage today please ack and drop any blockers. Heads up on two things: payments spikes in EU (gateway 502s) and embeddings timeouts for long docs. Updated a small macro below for refunds.

Sam: Acked, I'm on the P1 (#542). Seeing repeated 502s from gateway-eu-1 around 02:14–03:00. Dumped logs to the ticket.

Priya: I'm taking payments lead. Billing rolled a partial fix overnight but error rate still ~5% in EU. Adding monitoring dashboard link to the ticket. We may need to failover traffic to gateway-us for a short window.

Jorge: For embeddings timeouts — can you paste an example payload? I'm hitting timeouts >10s when doc >50k tokens with current batching. Might be a batching config regression after the reroute.

Lina: Example snippet pasted to the embeddings ticket (ticket 791). Also, small macro change: added an escalation step and `escalation_label` to the refund macro. Please use the shorthand `:refund_quick` going forward.

Lydia: I'll push a PR to update the macro definitions in `/repo/macros` and add a note about when to escalate to Billing. Assigning CR to Sam.

Sam: I can review the macro PR (#748) in the next 30m. Quick check: macro should include the `payment_gateway`, `txn_id`, and suggested next-step text for a manual refund.

Priya: If we decide to failover EU traffic, I propose a 20-minute maintenance window starting 10:30 UTC. I'll coordinate with infra. Any objections?

Jorge: No objections from me. I'll watch embeddings QPS and KV cache hit-rate during the window. If we see latency regressions I'll toggle the batching policy back.

Lina: Plan: Priya + Sam run failover 10:30–10:50 UTC, Jorge monitors embeddings, Lydia deploys macro PR once CR done. Ops-bot will create an incident if error rate >10% post-failover.

ops-bot: Alert created: payments-eu-502s (inc-202499). Current error rate: 4.8%. Assigned: Priya, Sam.

Sam: quick note — minor triage ask: please prefix any tickets you escalate with `ESCALATE/` so we can filter easily.

Lydia: Got it. I'll update the macro text to include that prefix and add a one-liner for support agents.

Priya: I'll start the coordination channel with infra and oncall. Tagging @infra-team in the ticket.

Lina: Thank you everyone. If you pick up any of the 11 high-priority items, drop a short note here so we avoid duplicate work. :thumbsup:
